# Workpaper Review Gate

> Local, deterministic readiness gate for Australian public-practice workpaper packs (BAS, month-end, year-end). `READY` means a pack may enter manager review; it is not sign-off.

## Package overview
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/review-ready-gate
- **Rust package**: `review-ready-gate` 1.0.0, binary only; native publishing blocked.
- **CLI command**: `review-ready`
- **Domain**: Local, deterministic readiness gating for Australian public-practice workpaper packs (BAS, month-end, year-end).
- **Control basis**: Required-artefact completeness, self-review assertions, open-item blocking, trial-balance integrity, GST 1A/1B tie-out, optional bank rec, year-end tie-out matrix, and prior-finding repeats.
- **Manager evaluation**: [evaluation/manager_review_gate/README.md](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/blob/main/packages/review-ready-gate/evaluation/manager_review_gate/README.md)
- **Missing evidence evaluation**: [evaluation/missing_evidence/README.md](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/blob/main/packages/review-ready-gate/evaluation/missing_evidence/README.md) (absent, empty, wrong-period and edited evidence; practitioner review pending)

## Core modules
- `src/engine.rs`: Builds `READY`, `NOT_READY` or `BLOCKED` packs.
- `src/loader.rs`: Validates input schemas and captures immutable source bytes and hashes.
- `src/report.rs`: Renders JSON, Markdown and CSV readiness files.
- `src/cli.rs`: Runs gate, view, compare, intake and view-document commands.
- `src/comparison.rs`: Verifies two runs and reports changed sources, findings and coverage.
- `src/viewer.rs`: Refuses ambiguous JSON or disagreeing artefacts before display.
- `src/publication.rs`: Admits one writer and preserves interrupted-publication evidence.

## Architectural boundaries

Build with Rust stable and the committed Cargo lockfile. Python is required only
for the feature-gated frozen baseline comparison; the runtime has no Python API.
1. **Gate, not review.** A `READY` pack may enter manager review. The tool does not decide that the work is correct.
2. **Acknowledgement never changes status.** A review note records that a human looked; it cannot flip `NOT_READY` or `BLOCKED` to `READY`.
3. **No operational authority.** The package does not post journals, lodge returns, or connect to Xero.
4. **Sibling tools.** Trial-balance variance review remains [Monthly Close Controls](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/monthly-close-control-plane). This gate sits upstream of that pack.
